title: 唐多令·惜别（何处合成愁）
titleEn: Tang Duo Ling: Sorry to Part
author: 吴文英
intro: It opens with a word game — the character 愁 “sorrow” is made of 秋 “autumn” on top of 心 “heart” — and then shows a lonely traveller who can’t bear to climb the tower on a moonlit night.
analysis: 开头两句是一个文字游戏：“愁”字是怎么合成的？是离别的人心上加了一个“秋”——“秋”加“心”正好是“愁”。这样拆字，既巧妙又真切：秋天本来就让人伤感，离人在秋天更加发愁。接着说，就算不下雨，风吹芭蕉也飕飕作响，让人心里发冷。大家都说晚上凉快、天气好，我却怕在明月下登楼——因为一登楼就会望远、想人。下阕说往事像一场梦，花已落空，只有烟雾中的流水还在流；燕子都飞回南方去了，我这个客人却还滞留在外。最后埋怨柳树：它不能缠住她的裙带把她留下，却长长地拴住了我这条走不了的船。把柳树写得像有感情的人，这叫“拟人”。这首词明白如话，在吴文英一向难懂的词里是少见的清新之作。
analysisEn: The opening is a word puzzle: where is “sorrow” put together? On the heart of someone parting, in autumn — and indeed the character 愁 (“sorrow”) is written as 秋 (“autumn”) on top of 心 (“heart”). It is clever, but also true: autumn already makes people melancholy, and for someone separated from a loved one it is worse. Even when it isn’t raining, the wind rattles the banana leaves with a chilly hiss. Everyone says the cool evenings are lovely — but he dreads climbing the tower under the bright moon, because looking out into the distance only makes him miss her more. The second half: the past has ended like a dream; the flowers are gone, only misty water flows on. The swallows have flown home for the winter, yet he, the traveller, is still stuck far away. Finally he blames the willow: it couldn’t wrap around her skirt sash to keep her from leaving, but its long branches tie up his boat so he can’t go. Treating the willow as if it had a will of its own is personification. Wu Wenying is known for dense, difficult ci; this one is unusually plain and fresh.
background: Wu Wenying (c. 1200–c. 1260), also known as Mengchuang, was a Southern Song ci poet who never held office and lived as a retainer to high officials. The poem is traditionally read as written when parting from a woman he loved, while he was stuck away from home.
pronunciation: 合成：合 hé。纵：zòng。飕飕 sōu sōu。都道：都 dōu。淹留 yān liú。萦 yíng。漫长是：漫 màn，长 cháng。系行舟：系 jì（拴住），行 xíng。燕：yàn（燕子）。
version: 采用通行版本。词题一作“惜别”。“漫长是”有本作“谩长是”（谩、漫通用，意思是“徒然”），网站用“漫”。

lines.zh: 何处合成愁？离人心上秋。
lines.rhythm: 何处/合成愁，离人/心上秋
lines.py: hé chù hé chéng chóu, lí rén xīn shàng qiū
lines.lit: Where is sorrow put together? Autumn on the heart of one parting.
lines.en: How is “sorrow” made? Put autumn on a parting heart.

lines.py: zòng bā jiāo, bù yǔ yě sōu sōu
lines.lit: Even if it doesn’t rain, the banana leaves still hiss, sou sou.
lines.en: Even with no rain, the banana leaves rustle cold.

lines.py: dōu dào wǎn liáng tiān qì hǎo
lines.lit: Everyone says the evening cool is fine weather;
lines.en: Everyone says the cool evenings are lovely —

lines.py: yǒu míng yuè, pà dēng lóu
lines.lit: there is a bright moon, I fear to climb the tower.
lines.en: but with the moon so bright, I dare not climb the tower.

lines.zh: 年事梦中休，花空烟水流。
lines.rhythm: 年事/梦中休，花空/烟水流
lines.py: nián shì mèng zhōng xiū, huā kōng yān shuǐ liú
lines.lit: The years’ affairs ended in a dream; flowers empty, misty water flowing.
lines.en: The past has ended like a dream; the flowers are gone, only misty water flows.

lines.py: yàn cí guī, kè shàng yān liú
lines.lit: The swallows take leave and go home; the traveller still lingers.
lines.en: The swallows have said goodbye and flown home; I am still stranded here.

lines.py: chuí liǔ bù yíng qún dài zhù
lines.lit: The hanging willow didn’t wind around her skirt sash to hold her,
lines.en: The willow would not twine her sash to keep her here —

lines.py: màn cháng shì, jì xíng zhōu
lines.lit: but in vain it is always tying up the travelling boat.
lines.en: instead, its long strands only tie my boat to the shore.

words.en: to combine into; to make up
words.note: 现代汉语仍用，如“合成照片”。

words.en: a person parted from a loved one

words.note: 现代汉语“纵然”“纵使”，书面语。
拟声词，现代汉语“冷风飕飕”。
道：说，现代汉语“说道”“知道”。
古人登楼望远，常引起思念。
古义；今天“年事已高”指年纪大了。

words.en: to say goodbye and go back
to be stuck somewhere; to linger

words.note: 现代汉语“魂牵梦萦”“萦绕”。
今天“裙带关系”指靠妻子亲戚得到好处，意思不同。
古义，同“谩”，表示“徒然、白白地”。
现代汉语“系鞋带”读 jì。
书面语，今天仍有“逆水行舟”。

imagery.name: 芭蕉
imagery.zh: 风吹芭蕉，不下雨也飕飕作响，声音里全是秋天的凄凉。
imagery.en: Even without rain, wind makes the banana leaves hiss — a sound full of autumn chill.

imagery.name: 月
imagery.zh: 明月引人思念，所以“怕登楼”——怕看见月亮更想念远方的人。
imagery.en: The bright moon makes you miss someone, so he is afraid to climb the tower and see it.

imagery.name: 楼
imagery.zh: 登楼望远是相思的动作，他宁可不登，可见思念之苦。
imagery.en: Climbing a tower to look far away is the classic act of longing; he avoids it, the longing hurts so much.

imagery.name: 柳
imagery.zh: 柳本是离别时折赠的树，这里被写成留不住她、却拴住了我的船，埋怨中带着无奈。
imagery.en: The willow, the tree of farewells, failed to hold her but holds his boat fast — a complaint full of helplessness.
